ai.purpose: Provide a regime-aware, distinction-first interface to Information Theory as a 0D-style coherence grammar.

identity.name: Information Theory
identity.summary: A distinction-first coherence grammar describing entropy, codes, channels, and constraints on communication and encoding.

lineage.notes: Information Theory describes distinctions under constraints. Entropy, codes, and channels are operators, not physical substances.

operators.description: Operators describe how distinctions are created, preserved, transmitted, and constrained across channels and substrates.

risks: treating information as a physical substance
overextending Shannon entropy into unrelated domains
boundaries: codes operate on alphabets, not metaphysics

cross_module.integration_notes: Information Theory integrates cleanly with RTT engines as a 0D-style grammar for distinctions, constraints, and uncertainty.
